name: shadow-rent-index
what_it_holds: Python/Selenium ETL pipeline (MIT license) that scrapes weekly rental listings from real-estate platforms for targeted zip codes in Madison, WI only, cleans with pandas (regex price cleaning, room-type extraction, outlier removal) and loads to a PostgreSQL time-series DB. No data committed to the repo itself; requires running the scraper (undetected-chromedriver) on a schedule to populate any history. Single small metro, 1 contributor, updated May 2026.
why_useful: Illustrates a 'zero-lag shadow rent index' methodology (listing-based nowcast ahead of official CPI shelter) that could in principle be re-pointed at broader geography, but as-is it is single-city and holds no usable committed data.
size_hint: no committed dataset; DB populated only by running scraper
themes: Housing and rent inflation nowcasts (Zillow observed rent, Apartment List, Fed rent nowcasts), new-tenant rent index, shelter CPI nowcasting repos
why_all: Illustrates a 'zero-lag shadow rent index' methodology (listing-based nowcast ahead of official CPI shelter) that could in principle be re-pointed at broader geography, but as-is it is single-city and holds no usable committed data.

name: rm (repeat-sales rent index)
what_it_holds: web2py application implementing a repeat-sales regression method to build a rental price index, tracking the same properties over time. Repo includes some reference data used for the calculation but the README does not specify whether production rent-listing data is committed or geography/date range covered (undocumented, 3 stars, last touched 2022).
why_useful: A working repeat-sales index construction method could be adapted to any committed or newly-collected rent panel to build a new-tenant-style rent index as an ABNB substitute-cost/backdrop indicator, but is unmaintained and its data scope is unclear.
size_hint: small reference dataset bundled with repo, size unstated
